holdings.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd

what_changed.text: HAL agreed to acquire CAE Canada's 50% stake in HATSOFF for nil consideration, turning it into a wholly-owned subsidiary within 60 days.
Anindya Biswas was appointed as Government Nominee Director starting 7 October 2026, replacing K Rajalakshmi Menon.
Executive Director (Finance) R Sriram retired on 30 September 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 5.36% portfolio weight, HAL is the fund's largest reported position. Its 3.31% gain over the past three months contributed an estimated +0.177% to fund return.

watch.text: Execution of Tejas Mk1A deliveries, identified by brokerages as a key milestone for HAL.

holdings.name: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd

what_changed.text: Syrma Johari MedTech inaugurated a 120,000+ sq. ft. facility in Jodhpur dedicated to medical plastics and precision molding.
The company entered into a partnership with Essencore to expand local manufacturing within India.
Syrma SGS was scheduled for addition to F&O trading starting October 28, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Syrma SGS is the fund's second-largest holding at 4.80% and its top 3-month positive contributor (+0.54%), posting an 11.24% return over the quarter.

watch.text: Board review and approval of Q2 and half-year FY2026-27 results on October 30, 2026.

holdings.name: Cyient DLM Ltd.

what_changed.text: Cyient DLM reported Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 393 crore and net profit of Rs 34 crore, compared to Rs 374 crore and Rs 16 crore in Q1 FY27.
The company granted 10,000 stock units and 2,63,400 options under its RSU 2023 and ASOP 2023 schemes.
The stock suffered a sharp 2-day decline of around 24% to 29% following Q2 results despite reporting higher profit.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 4.05% of the portfolio, Cyient DLM returned 12.39% over 3 months, contributing +0.502% to performance despite a steep 1-month decline of -21.80%.

watch.text: Interactions and guidance from the investor meet scheduled for 27 October 2026.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Axis Bank reported Q2 FY27 net profit of Rs 7,666 crore on total revenue of Rs 38,087 crore, compared to Rs 5,567 crore in Q2 FY26.
The bank appointed Rahul Shukla as Group Head of Commercial and Bharat Banking effective October 19, 2026.
Axis Bank's stock slid over 4% post-earnings as quarterly profit fell short of street expectations.

expected.text: Axis Bank's FY27 loan growth estimate was revised upward to 20%, while the FY28 projection was maintained at 15%.

seeing.text: The bank posted Q2 net profit of Rs 7,666 crore, but the shares fell over 4% after the quarterly profit missed analyst expectations.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.17% allocation, Axis Bank is the top financial service holding; it fell -0.80% over 3 months and -10.86% over 6 months.

watch.text: Delivery on the raised 20% loan growth forecast for FY27.

holdings.name: Bosch Ltd

what_changed.text: Bosch announced plans to reorganize its corporate structure by separating its Mobility business and three service units into subsidiaries.
Bosch received an ESG score of 76 and a 'leader' rating based on FY2025-26 disclosures.

holdings.why_it_matters: Bosch accounts for 3.13% of the fund. It gained 5.58% over the past 3 months and 20.16% over 6 months, supporting the Consumer Discretionary allocation.

watch.text: Board consideration of Q2 and half-year results scheduled for November 6, 2026.

holdings.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: Dixon signed a joint venture agreement with Gemtek to manufacture optical connectivity and telecom transceivers in India.
The company issued a US$7 million corporate guarantee on behalf of subsidiary Padget Electronics to Quanta Computer.
Dixon's stock retreated below its 200-day moving average amid a broader EMS sector pullback.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.04% fund weight, Dixon was one of the fund's primary detractors over 3 months, dropping -19.18% and generating an estimated drag of -0.583%.

watch.text: Approval of unaudited Q2 results and the accompanying conference call on 30 October 2026.

holdings.name: Timken India Ltd

what_changed.text: Pramesh Maheshwari was named President of India and Southeast Asia, while Anubhav Khajuria was elevated to GM-HR on 12 October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Timken carries a 2.91% allocation. The stock dropped -12.69% over 3 months and -22.39% over 6 months, contributing to drag across Industrials.

watch.text: Board meeting and conference call on 29 October 2026 to review Q2 and half-year financials.

holdings.name: AIA Engineering Ltd

what_changed.text: CRISIL ESG assigned AIA Engineering an ESG rating of 60 and Core ESG of 63 for FY2025-26.
The company organized institutional plant visits in late September 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.76% weight, AIA Engineering was the fund's largest detractor over 3 months, falling -21.90% and exerting an estimated drag of -0.604%.

holdings.name: Data Patterns (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: Data Patterns completed an agreement to acquire 100% of ST Advanced Composites for approximately Rs 10 crore.
CRISIL reaffirmed Data Patterns' bank facilities of Rs 775 crore at A+/Positive and A1.
Independent Director Sastry Venkata Rama Vadlamani ceased to hold office on September 9, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.74% weight, Data Patterns fell -17.28% over 3 months, creating an estimated return drag of -0.473% alongside other industrial names.

watch.text: Inclusion in the F&O trading segment starting October 28, 2026.

holdings.name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd

what_changed.text: Subsidiary KIME executed an agreement and acquired 100% of KTSPL for Rs 8.25 crore, effective 1 October 2026.
The company incorporated Kirloskar International B.V. in the Netherlands as a wholly-owned subsidiary.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.51% of the fund, Kirloskar Oil Engines dropped -18.23% over 3 months, subtracting an estimated -0.458% from total return.

portfolio.statement: Franklin India Multi Cap Fund is an equity scheme with 93.9% equity exposure concentrated heavily in Industrials (30.0%), Financials (16.8%), and Consumer Discretionary (15.5%).
interp: The portfolio maintains high exposure to capital goods and electronics manufacturing services, which caused sharp performance divergences across holdings.

While technology and selected manufacturing names like Syrma SGS and Cyient DLM drove quarterly gains, widespread pullbacks across midcap industrials (AIA Engineering, Data Patterns, Kirloskar Oil Engines) led to a 3-month decline of -5.74%.
portfolio.line: Heavy industrial and manufacturing allocations drove quarterly weakness as broad midcap industrial selloffs outweighed electronics gains.

drivers.text: Syrma SGS Technology (+11.24%) and Cyient DLM (+12.39%) contributed an estimated +0.54% and +0.502% respectively over the last 3 months.
Sharp three-month drops in AIA Engineering (-21.90%), Dixon Technologies (-19.18%), Kirloskar Oil Engines (-18.23%), and Data Patterns (-17.28%) each dragged performance down by more than 0.45%.

themes.title: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)
themes.text: Substantial portfolio allocation to contract manufacturing and electronics assembly experiencing valuation corrections and selective expansions.

themes.title: Domestic Defence and Aerospace
themes.text: Capitalization on local defence manufacturing orders, supply contracts, and engine deliveries.

macro.why: High valuation multiples combined with earnings sensitivities have driven sharp share-price swings in electronics manufacturing suppliers.
Procurement pace and platform delivery timelines dictate earnings predictability in aerospace and electronic defence suppliers.

priced_in.text: High forward growth expectations for EMS players, as evidenced by Cyient DLM's P/E of 71.6x and Syrma SGS's P/E of 71.8x.

could_change.title: Corporate Carve-Outs and Restructuring
could_change.text: The structural carve-out of Bosch's mobility and services divisions could alter its domestic operational integration.

could_change.title: Delivery Timelines in Aerospace
could_change.text: Execution rates on key defence deliveries such as the Tejas Mk1A will drive operational momentum for primary suppliers.

portfolio.risk_note: A 30% concentration in Industrials combined with elevated P/E multiples across EMS holdings leaves fund returns highly exposed to manufacturing corrections and order-execution delays.
